transforms.name: -se verb
transforms.description: A verb with a reflexive pronoun before it or attached to it, looked up in its -se form: me levanto → levantarse, te acuerdas → acordarse, siéntate → sentarse.

transforms.name: plural
transforms.description: Plural of a noun or adjective: casas, árboles, luces, canciones, jóvenes.

transforms.name: feminine
transforms.description: Feminine form of an adjective: bonita, trabajadora, inglesa, alemana, llorona, española, andaluza.

transforms.name: feminine noun
transforms.description: Feminine form of a noun for people: trabajadora, campeona, panadera, vecina, secretaria, bióloga, fotógrafa.

transforms.name: superlative
transforms.description: Absolute superlative in -ísimo: buenísimo, facilísimo, riquísimo, amabilísimo.

transforms.name: diminutive
transforms.description: Diminutive in -ito, -cito, -ecito: perrito, casita, cafecito, poquito, jovencito, pedacito, florecita.

transforms.name: -mente adverb
transforms.description: Adverb in -mente, looked up as its adjective: rápidamente → rápido, fácilmente → fácil.
